title: A tenant-safe analytics agent in your Next.js app with the AI SDK
outcome: Ship an analytics agent in your product: AI SDK chat with hypequery's tools, from Cloud or your own backend, and every answer stays in one customer.

env.name: HYPEQUERY_AGENT_KEY
env.description: Cloud mode: the signing key JSON hypequery Cloud shows once (Settings → Customer access → Signing keys for in-app agents). Names the project and its endpoint.

env.name: HYPEQUERY_MODE
env.description: Where the tools run: cloud (default, needs HYPEQUERY_AGENT_KEY) or self-hosted (in this app's backend, against your ClickHouse)

env.name: HYPEQUERY_PERMISSION_SET
env.description: The permission set end users act with (default customers)

env.name: AI_MODEL
env.description: Chat model as <provider>:<model id> (default anthropic:claude-opus-5-5; openai:<id> also works)

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.description: Anthropic API key, for the default model. Use OPENAI_API_KEY with an openai: model instead.

env.name: CLICKHOUSE_URL
env.description: Self-hosted mode and tests: the seed's ClickHouse HTTP endpoint (default http://localhost:8123)

env.name: CLICKHOUSE_USERNAME
env.description: Self-hosted mode and tests: ClickHouse user (default: default)

env.name: CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD
env.description: Self-hosted mode and tests: ClickHouse password (default: hypequery, the seed's password)

env.name: CLICKHOUSE_DATABASE
env.description: Self-hosted mode and tests: database holding the seed tables (default hypequery_examples)

exampleRequest: curl -s -c /tmp/hq-session -X POST localhost:3000/api/session -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"userId":"ada"}' && curl -s -b /tmp/hq-session -X POST localhost:3000/api/chat -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"messages":[{"id":"m1","role":"user","parts":[{"type":"text","text":"How many events did we have by type?"}]}]}'
